I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time clocks or live data feeds.  
To find the current time in New York City you can:

1. **Check a world‑clock website** (e.g., timeanddate.com/worldclock) and look up “New York” or “Eastern Time (US & Canada).”
2. **Use a smartphone or computer**: most devices automatically display the correct local time for New York if you set the time zone to “Eastern Time (US & Canada).”
3. **Ask a voice assistant** (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) – just say “What time is it in New York?”

If you need the time right now, you can also calculate it from UTC: New York is usually UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time (which is still in effect on October 26, 2026). So subtract four hours from the current UTC time.
